notes: Archived fork of SLOOP 2.8.3 adding a USB MIDI host mode and a generic fext module socket (for fble). README: "This fork of [SLOOP](https://github.com/isod89/sloop-fm1) carries two additions on top of SLOOP" GPL-3.0

name: Jozan-Mate-K's SLOOP
author: Jozan-Mate-K
notes: SLOOP fork with analog audio sync click and recordable punch FX (11 own commits, README unchanged). README: "SLOOP turns the FM-1 into a four-track groovebox you play live" GPL-3.0

name: mediaworkbench's Felucca
author: mediaworkbench
notes: Felucca 1.8.1 fork with Juno-106 DCO engine, BBD chorus, DrumBrain, 303 engine and TB-3PO tweaks README: "This is a fork of [Felucca Firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1](https://github.com/hugelton/Felucca)." GPL-3.0

name: mene311's Felucca (TRACKER)
author: mene311
notes: Felucca fork adding a tracker view (STEP page rows, drum lanes), FM-1 TRACKER v1.4 README: "FM-1 TRACKER v1.4-tr2 (commit message; README unchanged from upstream)" GPL-3.0

name: MONOEATER.NOISE
author: monoeater
notes: Cut-up noise firmware for FM-1 on FM1 Open V14: freeze wash, wash bend, latch, sequenced effects README: "MONOEATER.NOISE: FM-1 cut-up noise firmware. Added freeze wash, slow wash bend, effects after the wash, logo, latch, saved knobs, sequenced effects"

name: EDDA OS
author: Mr. Sheez
notes: Mr. Sheez performance fork of Felucca 1.7.0: EDDA songs, 16-WAV kits, CHORD+, DJ filter, Camelot key lock README: "This branch is EDDA OS 1.7.4, the Mr. Sheez performance fork of Felucca 1.7.0 (GPL-3.0)" GPL-3.0

name: JIANT SMK-37 (unofficial build)
author: pedeplei1281

name: sloop-peeeo
author: Pedro Nogueira Nunes
notes: Pedro Nogueira Nunes' personal SLOOP fork for live play: chord naming and CHORDS visualiser README: "sloop-peeeo is a personal fork of SLOOP by isod89, which is itself based on Felucca by Leo Kuroshita / Hügelton Instruments." GPL-3.0

name: ristiisa's SLOOP
author: ristiisa
notes: SLOOP fork with 47 own commits toward SLOOP 2.5 (prog, auto-fill, chord progressions); README unchanged README: "SLOOP 2.5: merge upstream 2.4.1 (commit message)" GPL-3.0

original_title: FM1 Open, Sideband fork by scottrabara
author: scottrabara
notes: FM1 Open V14 with protocol extensions for the Sideband sound editor (live DX7 edits, track map) README: "This fork of M-VAVE's FM1 Open adds a few protocol extensions for Sideband, a sound editor for the FM-1"

name: spinkham's Felucca
author: spinkham
notes: Felucca fork with a v1.0.3-div0fix test release and overflow/OTA safety fixes README: "Felucca 1.0.3-div0fix (test build) - release; README unchanged" GPL-3.0

name: n001se
author: Saintpid

name: fm1-nes
author: Keitark
notes: Development resources and board-support code for FM-1 custom firmware on the Jieli WL82 SDK, with a NES player as the worked example; app-only programming tested on V14 (2026-10-03). Own platform, not derived from another FM-1 project. Apache-2.0

name: FM-1 Doom (Keitark)
author: Keitark
notes: The original Doom engine on the FM-1, on Doomgeneric (pinned dcb7a8d) with an OPL synth (emu8950); an earlier build ran on hardware (2026-10-07), the latest candidate is not yet confirmed. GPL-2.0. Not related to the other two Doom ports (N:47, N:69), which use Felucca's hardware layer
